reviewedExternalMetadata.finding: The public API page says access is requested through the Contact form; no authenticated request was made and the page does not publish a bulk postcode perimeter release.
The public DCAT record identifies CYSTAT, CC BY 4.0, irregular updates and 2011 temporal coverage for the statistical distribution.
The address dataset is a separate address/point relation and reports about 4% coverage; it cannot close national postcode geometry or exact building display.

rights.postDirectory: The portal labels the official Post Code Directory CC BY 4.0. It establishes current assignment rows but contains no geometry.
rights.cystatGeometry: The portal labels dataset 481 CC BY 4.0. The exact GML is suitable for historical official-statistical context, not a current Cyprus Post perimeter.
rights.api: The current Cyprus Post API page requires a Contact-form request. No authentication, agreement or retention right was requested or assumed.

quality.assignmentCoverage: 1131 distinct four-digit codes occur in the 2024 street/community directory denominator.
quality.historicalGeometryCoverage: The 2011 GML matches 832 of 1131 current codes (73.56321839%); 299 current codes lack a matching historical polygon and 13 historical polygon codes are absent from the current denominator.
quality.confidence: current assignment high; historical statistical geometry high for its declared vintage; current operator-area visualization not established
quality.limitation: Temporal mismatch, incomplete code overlap and a malformed literal 2011-11-31 prevent promotion of the GML to current postcode-area authority.

blockerSummary: CY remains M1. The 2024 official directory provides 1131 current street/community postcode assignments but no geometry. The public CYSTAT GML provides 845 four-digit 2011 official-statistical geometries, only 832 of which match the current denominator; 299 current codes have no matching historical geometry and 13 historical codes are absent from current assignments. It is therefore not a current Cyprus Post perimeter, no approved immutable CY artifact exists, and the real API/app postcode-search-to-translucent-area path cannot be claimed.
unblockConditions: Obtain a current exact reusable postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon release, or a complete permitted current address/member relation suitable for a clearly derived surface, with code-class exclusions.
Pin edition, valid time, schema, declared coverage, rights, attribution and SHA-256; reconcile 2011 history separately and reject the malformed measurement end literal.

Publish an approved immutable artifact and pass CY normalization, EPSG:3048-to-4326 transform where applicable, geometry validity/topology, ambiguity, API, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, no-result/failure, clear and re-search tests on real data.
